usage: 青瓜 is a common vegetable used in salads and cooking.
It is usually green and crunchy when fresh.
You can eat 青瓜 raw or cooked.
In Cantonese, 青瓜 refers specifically to cucumber, not any melon.
青瓜 is often found in markets and grocery stores year-round.
